checks.title: Unit of measure incompatible with the quantity
checks.description: A magnitude carries a unit that does not measure its kind of quantity -- a pressure in litres, a length in seconds. The unit is a real unit and the link is the right link, so nothing structural can see it.
checks.remediation: Use a unit of the right kind, and check the mapping that chose it -- a wrong unit is usually a column read from the wrong place.
checks.cucumber_scenario: Every magnitude is measured in a unit of its own kind
